bias.en: Neutral · back on the 30 and 100-day averages
bias.zh: 中性 · 回到 30 日和 100 日均线

read.en: Amazon fell 1.7% on Oct 14 to $254.08. It slipped below its 5-day ($257.7) and 10-day ($255.6) averages and is holding just above the 30-day ($253.4) and 100-day ($252.5), both edging lower, and the 200-day ($242.5). MACD is still above its signal (since Oct 5) but the histogram is narrowing, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 2 ($252.6), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月14日下跌 1.7%，收于 $254.08。股价跌破 5 日（$257.7）和 10 日均线（$255.6），守在均小幅下行的 30 日（$253.4）和 100 日均线（$252.5）以及 200 日均线（$242.5）上方。MACD 仍位于信号线上方（自 10月5日起），但柱状图收窄，抛物线 SAR 自 10月2日起看多（$252.6），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close broke the $257 support tested four times in September, which turns into first resistance, then $263.7 (Oct 12 high, top of the range) and $267.6. The day's low of $252.66 held the $252.5–253.4 zone (30 and 100-day averages, SAR). A close below $252.5 would flip the SAR bearish and open $244–245 (Sep 16 and 28 lows).
read.zh: 收盘跌破 9月四次测试的 $257 支撑，该位置转为第一阻力，其上为 $263.7（10月12日高点，区间上沿）和 $267.6。当日低点 $252.66 守住 $252.5–253.4 区域（30 日和 100 日均线、SAR）。若收盘跌破 $252.5，SAR 将转为看空，并打开至 $244–245（9月16日和 28日低点）的空间。

r.en: Tested four times in September; 5-day average $257.7

s.en: Sep 16 and Sep 28 lows; 200-day average $242.5 below
